ns2:section.sectionText: Section BL1 is an online lecture, with lecture videos posted on Compass. This section requires registration in an online discussion section, either BD1 or BD2. This section has one or more proctored online exams, which may carry additional fees. Alternatively, in-person exams on campus will be offered at no cost. For up-to-date information about statistics course registration, please see our registration update pages: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Computer Engineering or Computer Science or Electrical Engineering or General Engineering or Materials Science & Engr or Mechanical Engineering or Statistics or Geology or Mathematics or Actuarial Science or Statistics & Computer Science or Math & Computer Science or Systems Engineering and Design or Aerospace Engineering or Undeclared or Agricultural & Biological Engr major(s).
